svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for EdTech product design. Piles of books rise as a staircase on a dotted floor, one book higher each step, toward a graduation cap on the top pile. A learner stands on the second step holding a blue tablet that shows the course: two lessons ticked and the next lesson as one lime row. The book on the next step up is lime too, and a dashed line runs from the tablet’s lime row to it, so the next lesson in the app is the learner’s next step up.
